Strategic architects of Value.

HAYKALAH has moved from advising on structures to building, operating and taking equity in them.

HAYKALAH is a Saudi-born structuring house that designs, implements, operates and monitors what it structures. It was founded by bankers with Islamic-finance backgrounds, has worked since 2004 and operates from Riyadh and Jeddah. Its name is the Arabic word for “structuring”. We serve family offices and trusts, founders and private investors, sovereign and government entities, banks and financial institutions, and international companies.

Advise → build → operate → own

Our model has grown with the record. We still advise, and we now stay to build, operate and own a share of what we structure.

  1. 01

    Advise

    One deliverable chain, from market research and feasibility to the information memorandum, term sheet and due diligence, shows whether a project works and on what terms.

  2. 02

    Build

    We form the company, obtain its approvals, seat its board and bring in partners, lenders and investors. Any regulated step runs through a CMA-authorised institution.

  3. 03

    Operate

    We execute or supervise each workstream, appoint operators under contract and report to the board against agreed KPIs.

  4. 04

    Own

    Board seats, our own ventures and equity-for-build, with partner equity vesting at agreed gates, tie our reward to the venture’s progress.

From fee to equity

The commercial model moved with it:

  1. 2007–12

    retainer and success fee.

  2. 2013–19

    board seats and principal ventures.

  3. 2020–23

    implementation mandates, in which HAYKALAH stays through company formation.

  4. 2024–26

    equity-for-build, fees deferred into project equity, and DevCo stakes.

We are not choosing between advisory and ownership. We are using advisory and execution to create the value.

Six ways we create value

Six features describe how HAYKALAH creates value for its clients. Each one stands for work we actually do, and the Signature work explorer can be filtered by them.

  1. 01

    Innovation

    We design the structure a deal needs, even when no template exists.

    See it in practice: Strategic financial and capital structuring (FINA.)
  2. 02

    Monetization

    We turn assets that cost money to hold into recurring income and capital.

    See it in practice: Turning expenses into revenue
  3. 03

    Optimization

    We test every option before capital is committed, then choose the best use, cost and control.

    See it in practice: Real estate structuring and execution
  4. 04

    Automation

    We automate reporting, records and routine operations, so people spend their time on judgment.

    See it in practice: Digital transformation
  5. 05

    Transformation

    We change how an organization, an asset or a portfolio works, from governance to data.

    See it in practice: Digital transformation
  6. 06

    Commercialization

    We take ideas, knowledge and public assets to market with a business model, an operator and paying users.

    See it in practice: Venture building and execution

These six describe what HAYKALAH does for clients. They are different from the four knowledge eras in our heritage below (Accumulate, Commercialize, Monetize, Utilize), which trace how HAYKALAH’s own know-how was built.

How each one works

Heritage 2004–2026

HAYKALAH’s archive records 22 years of work in six chapters. Our founding line is “Since 2004”.

HAYKALAH Financial Advisory · Commercial Registration No. 7014123751

Six chapters

The know-how behind these chapters built up in four overlapping eras: Accumulate (2004–12), Commercialize (2008–16), Monetize (2014–22) and Utilize (2023 to today). Our approach explains how they feed every new mandate.

Chapters and eras from HAYKALAH’s archive; dates indicative. All figures indicative; outcomes are recorded in HAYKALAH files. Clients are not named until they consent. The founder’s career before HAYKALAH appears on the Leadership page, labelled as earlier career.

  1. 2004–06

    Foundation

    Bankers with Islamic-finance backgrounds found HAYKALAH.

  2. 2007–09

    Mega projects

    Feasibility, valuation and financial advisory for large Holy Cities projects: pilgrim housing designed for about 85,000 pilgrims, a five-star hotel 700 m from the Haram and a mixed-use development 500 m from the Haram. Mandates are paid by retainer and success fee.

  3. 2010–12

    Breadth and cross-border

    SAR 186m raised in five weeks for a new 100-bed Jeddah hospital, the downtown Jeddah regeneration model, hotel and retail work in central Madinah, a refinery project in Malaysia and a Saudi-Turkish asset-management company. The 2011 register lists 38 client projects, most not closed.

  4. 2013–19

    Codify and build ventures

    The commercial model moves to board seats and principal ventures, and the work of the first decade is codified into playbooks. AS3A, a flexible-work platform, starts in 2019.

  5. 2020–23

    Execute

    Implementation mandates in which HAYKALAH stays through company formation: capital structuring and company building for pilgrim-services companies, a bank process for over SAR 1bn of Holy Sites works (2022) and Mashaer pricing (2023). Arsann, built from a 2010 parking study, is sold in 2023.

  6. 2024–26

    Platform

    Equity-for-build and DevCo stakes, the Makkah informal-area redevelopment (signed 2024), HOAM screening and a PPP consortium in formation. The 2025–26 book holds about 35 live mandates and ventures.

Questions

When was HAYKALAH founded?

HAYKALAH has worked since 2004. It was founded by bankers with Islamic-finance backgrounds.

What does the name HAYKALAH mean?

HAYKALAH (هيكلة) is the Arabic word for “structuring”.

Where does HAYKALAH work?

From offices in Riyadh and Jeddah. HAYKALAH has worked on, studied or proposed engagements in 16 countries on four continents, 2004–2026 (indicative).

How are the six ways of creating value different from the four knowledge eras?

The six features, Innovation, Monetization, Optimization, Automation, Transformation and Commercialization, describe what HAYKALAH does for clients. The four eras, Accumulate, Commercialize, Monetize and Utilize, trace how HAYKALAH’s own know-how was built.

Is HAYKALAH regulated by the Capital Market Authority?

HAYKALAH is not an Authorised Person of the CMA. Securities business and investment-fund activities in a transaction are carried out by a CMA-authorised institution engaged for that transaction.
